scene halloweenfourmingle1
: Is it just me or does Ayane’s party room seem a little more green than normal this year?
: And is it just me or has her taste in Halloween decor gotten even stranger?
: I will have you know that I had nothing to do with the decor and that everything here has been personally chosen by Geoffrey and his son.
: Their existence continues to become stranger and stranger each time you bring them up.

We make it to Ayane’s mansion before the sun sets and, as always, it is fully stocked with a variety of food and adolescent bodies that I will one day put my penis inside (assuming I have not already done that).
Also, just to clarify as that sentence could be easily misread or misheard as something else, I have no intention of putting my penis inside any food.
At least not while I’m fully conscious. But at the rate things seem to be going today, who even knows?

I’m fine now, though. I’m as peachy as a peach. As Jolly as a rancher. And as excited as a small dog being hand-fed chocolate moments before discovering his body can not process it only to subsequently die.

Is this me saying I’m going to die today? Of course not. There’s no way that could be true. Or at least I hope it isn’t true as there are still so many foods here I’ve yet to put my penis inside. Wait. No. I meant girls.

I have to stop thinking of one thing while looking at another thing. I need to act like my head isn’t falling off when I know it is. I should stand still so my brain stops rattling. I should speak and break the silence.
: It’s boner time.
scene halloweenfourmingle2
I did it. I said something normal. The day is saved.
: Uhhhhh, what?
: I don’t think it’s boner time right now, Sensei. Did you mean to say “party time” maybe?
: I feel like that would be even more out of character.
: Can you maybe wait until the party is at least halfway over to start sexually harassing everyone? I haven’t built up my daily immunity to nonsense just yet.
I made a mistake. Everything I do is a mistake. Somebody feed me chocolate before I devour a cat.
: Do you want to go lie down? I can have Geoffrey go lay out a futon for you and you can rejoin us when you’re not as...tired.
: I think that’s a good idea. I’ll go with him.
scene halloweenfourmingle3
: Yeah, because that is safer than letting him flop around like a fish out of water.
: Fish can’t survive outside of water and Sensei can’t survive without me. You guys go have fun. I’ll go rub his head and sing him lullabies.
: I’m fine. I can assimilate. I think I’m just a little behind on sleep. But going around and saying hello to everyone will wake me up. It’s the beginning of a special event, so I have to do that.
: Once I do that, things will fall back into place and everything will be normal again. I’ve figured out the process.
: Well somebody should do something before-
scene halloweenfourmingle4
: ...and there he goes.
: He hasn’t been this way all morning, has he?
: He didn’t even wake up until past noon today. And when he finally did, he thought I was you.
scene halloweenfourmingle5
: Is that what you were alluding to with that thing about...pranks you said earlier? Did he say something to you?
: He said a few things to me. But I’m a good niece now and I’m not going to pry into anyone’s business anymore. I’ll just silently doubt you instead.
: Ami, whatever he said, I’m sure it was just-
: You look really cute in that costume, Maya.
scene halloweenfourmingle6
: ...thanks.
: I’m gonna head over to the buffet. Should I grab a plate for you as well? Or would you rather just pick the scraps off of mine?
: I...can get my own plate, Ami...
: Really? That’s news to me.
: Weren’t you two supposed to be on better terms now? Whatever happened to that?
scene halloweenfourmingle7
: Hah...fate, maybe?
: Let’s just forget all of this ever happened and try to enjoy ourselves for a few hours.
scene halloweenfourmingle8
Welcome to the first ever “special” update for Lessons in Love, a game about being happy!
If you’re not already familiar with how to play, here is a quick tutorial.
Step one: Pay close attention to everything everyone says — because you never know when someone might be foreshadowing something!
Step two: Ignore step one and come up with your own abstract idea for the story you want to read. Then, disregard any information that does not support it as unreliable narration.
Step three: Grind affection and lust points to use as currency for future sex scenes. Just not too many of them because you might eventually be punished for it!
Step four: Accept that you might eventually be punished for things you didn’t even realize you were doing incorrectly because life is unfair and mean and everything should be about you all the time.
Step five: Everything is always about you. All the time. Always.
Step six: Reinforce that belief! As hard as you can! Everything revolves around you! You are the best!

Step seven: Forget step two, then remember step one. Grind your ideas into dust and sprinkle them throughout the three halves of the city so that there are little bits and pieces of them in everything.
Step eight: See the world through someone else’s eyes. Taste the dust of your thoughts for the very first time with the tongues of other unknowing creatures.
Step nine: Forget steps five and six. Remember step four. Then contemplate giving up altogether because none of this makes any sense. Proceed to the tenth step.
Step ten: Ignore steps one, three, four, five, six, seven, and eight. Reinforce step two. But remember what you gave away in exchange for that.
Remember how much information you ground up into dust and sprinkled all across the city (See step seven). Think about what it could have meant if steps two and five and six never existed.
And there you go! That’s how you play Lessons in Love! Easy, right?
It’s only as complicated as you make it.
So why do you always make it so complicated?
: Party time.
scene halloweenfourmingle9
: ...and that’s why I think sex robots will one day be a regular household item.
: I’ve never been more excited for the future than I am right now.
: Hey. Congratulations on being the first two girls I approached at this party.
scene halloweenfourmingle10
: Oh, Sensei! You just missed my story about sex robots.
: Good evening, Father. Peace be with you.
: And also with you. Why are you a nun?
scene halloweenfourmingle11
: Obviously because it is my sworn duty to share the truth and the good word with everyone. And there is no outfit more fitting for such a duty than that of a sister.
: Also, there is something particularly alluring about wearing such an outfit without undergarments. Which, I will have both of you know, is precisely the state I am in right now.
: Could be worse. You could be wearing mine again.
: And what are you supposed to be, Rin?
scene halloweenfourmingle12
: Zone-tan! Who, like Nodoka right now, probably doesn’t wear underwear either. But I will have you know that I am. Which you probably didn’t need to know, but still. Hi.
: I still don’t have any idea what that is.
: Good. Please preserve whatever image you have of me and don’t look her up.
: Will do. Why is it just you two over here, though? What’s going on with Otoha and Futaba?
scene halloweenfourmingle13
: Otoha couldn’t make it and...I could have sworn Futaba told you about the animosity between her and Nodoka right now.
: Oh, right. I think I was supposed to talk to you about that, Nodoka.
: Have you come to discipline me for being a bad girl, Akira?
: Please don’t call me that when there are others here who don’t know that name yet. And no, I’m not going to discipline you. I’m just supposed to tell you to stop publishing your book.
scene halloweenfourmingle14
: And why would I do that?
: Because it’s going to ruin your relationship with the one person you seem to have actual feelings for.
: I’m assuming that you’re referring to Futaba right now. Which calls into question exactly what you think my feelings for you are.
: Do you not believe you are important to me, Akira? Because I thought I made it quite audibly apparent that you are.
: You have no intention of stopping, do you?
: I do not. I’m far too fond of the way it feels to insert myself into the shoes of the many other girls you’ve violated. But I believe Futaba will come around to see things my way eventually.
: There is no malice in what I do. If the costume is not a sign enough- I seek to save, not to destroy.
: Nodoka, I don’t really think you’re understanding exactly how betrayed Futaba feels by you. I doubt this is a thing that even she is going to just “come around” to.
scene halloweenfourmingle15
: But you’ve already come around, haven’t you? Otherwise, you’d be with her instead of me.
: She’s pissed off at me too, you know. Plus, there’s not really anything I feel like I have to hide since I didn’t lose my virginity to my high school teacher.
: From what I’ve seen in reader feedback, most people wish you would have.
: Can you at least apologize to her or something? It feels weird watching her avoid you when she’s been your number one fan for basically forever.
: I will consider it. This outfit does put me in a charitable mood, after all.
scene halloweenfourmingle16
: A very charitable mood, might I add. Perhaps there is something I could assist you with, Akira?
: A confession, perhaps? The “word of the lord?” A discreet handjob under the table as we gaze into one another’s eyes?
: Nodoka, come on. I know these tablecloths are long, but there’s no way you’d be able to pull that off without somebody catching on.
scene halloweenfourmingle17
: So long as that somebody is you, I see no issue. You could even assist me if you’d like. There’s more than enough of him to go around, Rin. Otoha never has to know.
: I...think I’m gonna pass. So, sorry to all of your readers, but they’re going to have to wait a little longer.
: How unfortunate. Such a chapter would be sure to stir something inside of Futaba and I’m interested in seeing how that would change the dynamic between the two of you.
: Yeah...I’m not.
: Well, I guess I’ll be the one to go hang out with her since neither of you two are going to do it.
scene halloweenfourmingle18
: I want to! She just-
scene halloweenfourmingle19
: Hey. What are you doing all alone? Even if you’re at odds with Rin and Nodoka, there are still a couple tables full of girls who would be happy to have you.
: You weren’t just talking about me to them, were you?
: Was I...not supposed to do that?
scene halloweenfourmingle20
: Hah...no. You weren’t. They know what they did wrong and I don’t need your assistance when it comes to making them feel bad about it.
: I guess you were just trying to help, though...
: I just don’t really like seeing you alone like this. You’re pretty much always talking to someone at these parties.
: I just wanted to be alone for a little while, that’s all.
scene halloweenfourmingle21
: Honestly, I wasn’t even sure if I was going to come or not. I’m not the biggest fan of...the way I look this year, so...
: Why not? You look great.
: The costume itself is beautiful. Molly did a wonderful job- especially on such short notice. I don’t typically show off as much of my thighs as this, so...
: Well, if it’s any consolation, I’ve seen much more of your thighs than that.
scene halloweenfourmingle20
: You’re a special case. You’ve seen more of me than anyone. There’s even a book about it now.
: I take it that means you still feel the same way about it that you did in my office?
scene halloweenfourmingle21
: Honestly...I barely remember how that conversation went. But I’m definitely not okay with it if that’s what you’re asking.
: I’m just glad that no one else in our class really reads. That’s...pretty much the only thing keeping me going at the moment.
: But now there’s this...added layer of pressure any time anyone looks at me.
scene halloweenfourmingle22
: That’s always been there, of course. You understand by now the way I see myself. It’s just...worse knowing that someone could be seeing through that.
: I...I get that anyone who doesn’t know our story specifically isn’t going to assume I’m just the...real-life version of a character from a book-
: But just because it’s an irrational way of thinking doesn’t mean I have any idea how to make it stop.
: If controlling my brain were that simple, I would have started doing it years ago.
: Everything’s going to be okay, Futaba.
scene halloweenfourmingle20
: I hope you’re right, Sensei.
: But if it’s not a problem, I think I’d like to go back to being a loner for a little while. I’m not really in a talking mood right now.
: Fine by me. But, should you find yourself wanting to talk to someone, Rin does seem at least mildly remorseful.
: Nodoka, on the other hand-
: Is likely incapable of even feeling such a thing. I know.
: As long as you know. I’ll see you around, Futaba.
: I hope you won’t. That would mean I’m actually standing out.
scene black
scene halloweenfourmingle23
: Heeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeeey...
: Am I pretty?
: No, but Karin sure is.
scene halloweenfourmingle24
: Ah! How dare you! Do you have any idea what fate will befall you now?!
: Hahah! Me! Pretty! Hahaha! Haha! Adjectives!
: At least you’re not fainting upon receiving compliments anymore.
: It’s...you know, it’s...this isn’t even my dress. You should have seen my mom wearing it. Just not...not like, during the wedding. Because that would mean you’d probably be my dad.
: Unless...Unless you were just invited to the...
scene halloweenfourmingle25
: I’d marry you right now if it wouldn’t send you into a coma.
scene halloweenfourmingle26
: And down she goes.
: First you insult me...then you put my friend into a coma? Are you trying to incur my wrath today?
: What are you even supposed to be? A...sick geisha?
scene halloweenfourmingle27
: Kuchisake-onna obviously! How are you this unfamiliar with Japanese urban legends?! You live in Japan!
: Why are you this familiar with them when you weren’t even allowed to leave your family’s manor until a year ago?
scene halloweenfourmingle28
: I’m okay. Nobody worry about me.
: You seem to forget how well-read I am, Sensei. And how my interests extend far beyond forks and kyudo down the darkest corridors of Japanese folklore.
: The tale of Kuchisake-onna dates back to well over a thousand years ago when the wife of a samurai-
: Save the history lesson for school. I’m here to party.
scene halloweenfourmingle29
: Then learn to party in a way that doesn’t make me want to slash your face from ear to ear!
: Well, that doesn’t sound like a very good party at all.
: What’s your...ideal party even like, Sensei? If you had to organize something like this, how would it go?
: You’d be wearing the same thing, but we’d be in a church roughly ten feet in front of the altar.
scene halloweenfourmingle30
: Hah...
: Two points for me. I’m taking a commanding lead early, Terumi. You’re going to have to work harder if you want to catch up.
: Would it kill you to not torment the poor girl? She’s clearly inexperienced when it comes to men.
: And you aren't?
: Frankly, I feel as though the short time we’ve shared together is more than sufficient in terms of preparing me for any other male I should ever come across.
: But even if that were not the case, malevolently tapping into someone’s weakness for your own personal pleasure is not a very kind thing to do and you should be ashamed.
: Tapping into someone’s weakness? You mean like how I call you different names starting with T all the time?
: Yes. Though, I’m not sure wanting to be treated with respect is a “weakness.”
: Well, it’s not my fault I haven’t figured out any others yet. You’re too perfect and it’s annoying.
: That-
scene halloweenfourmingle31
: That was actually very sweet. Thank you.
: Hi, it’s me. Karin. I’m back again. And my head hurts now.
: Please don’t say anything else that will cause her to collapse. You’re going to give the girl a concussion.
scene halloweenfourmingle32
: Fine, but only because I don’t want Ayane’s family being somehow held responsible for-
A sudden tapping on my shoulder pulls me from one conversation where my decisions have led to someone getting hurt-
